# Numerical parity fixtures

The fixtures contain 14 sequences and 457 tokens selected from the previous
512-sequence Python reference. The selection keeps the shortest and longest
sequences and one representative of every predicted speech-act and schedule-kind
class present in the original fixture. All five model heads remain covered.

The stored values are exact slices of the existing reference, not output
regenerated by the TypeScript inference being tested. Model weights were not
changed. The runtime tests compare every retained value and check padding.

Original sequence indices are `0, 1, 3, 4, 10, 11, 14, 21, 24, 30, 56, 149, 250, 304`.

The original fixture SHA256 hashes were:
